mechanical_edges: unordered upright 0/90-normalized box multiset; dimensions rounded to 1mm and actual mass to .01kg; exact ordered arrival signature also recorded
near_duplicate: multiset intersection/min cardinality >= .90 AND min/max cardinality >= .90; mass included; ignore arrival ordering conservatively; transitive union; no outcome fields
admission: UNSEEN requires positive closed exposure provenance covering policy/model/selection use. Missing local hit alone is insufficient. Any contaminated component is excluded. Current static access recorded separately.
history_scope: allowlisted source/plan/input/split/exposure metadata in both outputs roots; v1 annotation source mappings; skip snapshots, requests, responses, code and candidate-only exposure lists
unknown_history: No claim to audit external/deleted/unrecorded runs. Unattested remaining components stay UNKNOWN_EXPOSURE.
minimum_basis: small descriptive validation across 3 length strata, 2 sources per stratum, not a power calculation; no pilot variance estimates exist
static_access: JN4-A metadata/geometry/mass access, no policy/model tuning or formal trajectory
